causalDistinctness: Hourly divergence between completed-hour price return and open-interest percentage change; distinct from prior project basis, funding, price-volume, positioning-level, momentum, reversal, seasonality, breakout and equity hypotheses.

externalHypothesisEvidence.source: IliassSjm/crypto-perps-alpha public HEC Paris course project, oi_divergence_alpha.py
externalHypothesisEvidence.sourceStatus: hypothesis-generating external evidence only; not accepted as project validation
externalHypothesisEvidence.sourcePortfolio: cross-sectional rank weights; rank/sum(abs(rank)) then subtract cross-sectional mean; next-hour return via positions.shift(1)
externalHypothesisEvidence.sourceCostCaveat: external study used zero transaction cost for the standalone signal and explicitly warns that realistic crypto costs are binding
externalHypothesisEvidence.signLocked: continuation in alpha score: long highest (price strength relative to OI change), short lowest

dataAuthority.metrics: Binance official data.binance.vision USD-M daily metrics archives
dataAuthority.price: Binance official data.binance.vision USD-M monthly 1h klines
dataAuthority.oiSampling: last valid 5-minute metrics snapshot strictly before each UTC hour boundary; snapshot age must be >0 and <=10 minutes
dataAuthority.priceReturn: completed hourly open-to-next-open return ending at the decision boundary
dataAuthority.execution: apply signal-generated weight at decision hour boundary to the next open-to-open hourly return
dataAuthority.missingData: fail closed per symbol-hour; no interpolation of open interest or price

cohort.selectionRule: all 25 current-active Binance Spot-USDT + USD-M PERPETUAL symbols onboarded by 2025-10-15 that were absent from the V20 outcome-exposure union and ARP22 cohort after excluding multiplier/stable/commodity-backed contracts; fixed in onboarding order before ARP23 outcomes

portfolio.ranking: pandas-compatible ascending average rank on alpha; lexical order only for deterministic data assembly, not tie-breaking of equal values
portfolio.weightFormula: rank / sum(abs(rank)) then subtract cross-sectional mean; no gross renormalization

costs.chargedOn: sum absolute change in underlying portfolio weights each hour plus terminal liquidation

failureRule: Any development gate failure closes ARP23-OID1 with no sign, lag, cohort, cost, breadth or threshold rescue. Validation and sealed holdout remain sealed. Passing development authorizes only unchanged fresh validation.
